"""Send a lumen-meshing status email over Gmail SMTP.

Reuses the app-password credentials already set up for bullet281
(pipeline/.gmail_creds) -- MCP Gmail can't send, and cron/headless has no
Claude session anyway, so smtplib is the only route that works unattended.

Usage:
    python bin/notify_email.py "<subject>" "<body>"
    python bin/notify_email.py --status      # build the body from the progress CSVs
"""
import smtplib
import ssl
import subprocess
import sys
from email.message import EmailMessage
from pathlib import Path

CREDS = Path("/home/jeff/bullet281/pipeline/.gmail_creds")
HERE = Path("/home/jeff/project/65_final_0723")
TO = "kimse991228@gmail.com"


def load_creds():
    sender = password = None
    for line in CREDS.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        if "=" in line:
            k, v = line.split("=", 1)
            k, v = k.strip().lower(), v.strip()
            if k in ("sender", "email", "user") or "@" in v:
                sender = v
            elif k in ("password", "pass", "app_password"):
                password = v
        elif "@" in line:
            sender = line
        else:
            password = line
    if not sender or not password:
        sys.exit(f"[notify_email] {CREDS} 파싱 실패")
    return sender, password


def status_body():
    """Summarise both grid batches straight off disk."""
    done = len(list(HERE.glob("fluid_0723/case_*/meshing/mesh-complete/mesh-complete.mesh.vtu")))
    alive = subprocess.run(
        ["pgrep", "-f", "mesh_all_g015[.]py"], capture_output=True
    ).returncode == 0
    lines = [
        f"완료: {done} / 384",
        f"배치 프로세스: {'실행 중' if alive else '중단됨'}",
        "",
    ]
    for tag, grid in (("g010", "0.01"), ("g015", "0.015")):
        csv = HERE / f"lumen_meshing_{tag}_progress.csv"
        if not csv.exists():
            continue
        rows = [r.split(",") for r in csv.read_text().splitlines()[1:] if r.strip()]
        ok = [r for r in rows if r[1] == "done"]
        bad = [r for r in rows if r[1] != "done"]
        if not ok:
            continue
        tets = sum(int(r[3]) for r in ok) / len(ok)
        secs = sum(int(r[4]) for r in ok) / len(ok)
        lines.append(
            f"[grid {grid}] {len(ok)}개 완료, 실패 {len(bad)}개 — "
            f"평균 {tets:,.0f} tets, {secs:.0f}초/case"
        )
    return "\n".join(lines)


def send(subject, body):
    sender, password = load_creds()
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg["From"] = sender
    msg["To"] = TO
    msg.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP_SSL("smtp.gmail.com", 465, context=ssl.create_default_context()) as s:
        s.login(sender, password)
        s.send_message(msg)
    print(f"[notify_email] sent to {TO}: {subject}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "--status":
        send("[lumen meshing] 진행 상황", status_body())
    else:
        send(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "")
